title: RevClamp ContactPulse - B2B Domain Contact, RFC 9116 & Deliverability Enricher
description: Extract verified B2B role contacts, RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt disclosures, Schema.org ContactPoint JSON-LD, de-obfuscated emails, social links, and DNS-over-HTTPS MX/SPF/DMARC deliverability posture across B2B domains. Leave defaults intact and click Start to run an instant verification query for stripe.com.

query.title: Target B2B Domain(s) or Company URL
query.description: Single domain or comma/space-separated B2B domains/URLs (e.g. 'stripe.com', 'linear.app, cloudflare.com, shopify.com, github.com').

roleFilter.title: Contact Role Filter (Optional)
roleFilter.description: Filter extracted contacts by functional B2B department role.

includeDnsPosture.title: Include DNS MX / SPF / DMARC Deliverability Posture
includeDnsPosture.description: Resolve MX gateway provider, SPF policy, and DMARC enforcement posture via DNS-over-HTTPS.

includeSecurityTxt.title: Include RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt Inspection
includeSecurityTxt.description: Parse RFC 9116 security.txt fields (Contact, Expires, Encryption, Policy, Acknowledgments, Hiring).

maxResults.title: Max Enriched Domain Profiles to Return
maxResults.description: Maximum number of enriched B2B domain profiles to return in a single call (bounded to 1..25).

pageToken.title: Pagination Cursor Token (Optional)
pageToken.description: Opaque deterministic pagination cursor (rcd1_...) returned by a previous call to resume fetching the next slice.
